retrievalProfile.description: A stroboscopic multiple-exposure portrait featuring a central figure in motion against a dark background, characterized by vibrant overlapping color trails and diagonal typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition where a female figure is captured in a sequence of movements, creating a 'ghosting' effect of overlapping silhouettes. The subject wears a highly saturated floral pattern that smears into a kaleidoscope of red, yellow, and green streaks against a deep black void. Text is placed at opposing 45-degree angles in the upper corners to frame the motion.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject motion trails radiating from a central vertical axis
High-contrast relationship between vibrant subject and pitch-black background
Diagonal text alignment mirroring the upward energy of the pose
Overlapping transparency levels creating depth through repetition
coreInvariants: Saturated floral or patterned garment as the primary color source

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupying 70% of the vertical frame, expanding horizontally through motion trails.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The most defined face on the right side of the motion sequence.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the motion trails from left to right, then move upward to the diagonal text elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the figure, emphasizing the light and color of the motion.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the subject's clothing contrasted against zero-value black.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-key primary colors in the motion trails

composition.position: Top Left and Top Right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color variation to distinguish artist from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and clean uppercase look.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uniform stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a stroboscopic multiple-exposure photograph of a woman in a vibrant floral dress dancing against a black background. The image should show 3-4 overlapping transparent stages of her movement, creating colorful light trails.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left (white) and top right (orange) corners, both tilted upwards at a 20-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Are there at least three distinct overlapping exposures?
Does the floral pattern create vibrant color streaks?

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth transparency in overlapping layers
Ensure text does not obscure the primary face
Verify the diagonal alignment of all text elements
Confirm the absence of any modern digital artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Stroboscopic Motion + Floral Pattern + Black Void + Diagonal Geometric Type
